Inglewood, California
  June 30, 2020

The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
Tuesday, June 30, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

MAYOR PRO TEM APPOINTMENT. It was moved by Council Member
Franklin, and seconded by Council Member Padilla that the City Council does
hereby appoint Council Member Morales as Mayor Pro Tem for Closed Session.
The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes:  Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Franklin;
Noes:  None; and
Absent:  Mayor Butts.

Mayor Pro Tem Morales called the City Council into Closed Session at the hour
of 1:01 p.m.
The Acting City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:
  Present:  Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Franklin, and
  Mayor Pro Tem Morales; and
  Absent:  Mayor Butts.
City officials and personnel present for closed session were as follows:

  Aisha Thompson  Acting City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Ken Campos  City Attorney
  Jacquelyn Gordon  Staff Assistant

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS. Mayor
Pro Tem Morales inquired if there were any persons present who wished to
address the City Council on Closed Session Item Nos. CS-1 and CS-2.

There was no response.

Mayor Pro Tem Morales recessed the City Council at the hour of 1:02 p.m. for
Closed Session Item Nos. CS-1 and CS-2.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called
the City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing
Authority, and Joint Powers Authority at the hour of 2:02 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/Joint
Powers Authority Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing
  Authority Chairman/Joint Powers Authority
  Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor
  Agency  Members/Housing  Authority
  Members/Joint Powers Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.

City/Successor Agency / Housing Authority /Joint Powers Authority officials and
personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha Thompson  Acting City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Jacquelyn Gordon  Staff Assistant

 June 30, 2020

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, and Joint
  Powers Authority.

  SUBSEQUENT NEED ADDED TO AGENDA – EXECUTIVE ORDER NO.
  20-06. It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council
  Member Franklin that there is a subsequent need to be placed on the Agenda as
  Consent Calendar number 5. The motion was carried by the following roll call
  vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Noes: None.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts
  inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City
  Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Joint Powers Authority on any
  item on the Agenda.

  There was no response.

 142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member
  /Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Franklin, and seconded
  by Council Member /Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member
  Morales that the demands presented to the City Council/Successor
  Agency/Housing Authority dated June 25, 2020, in the amount of $3,887,257.72,
  are hereby allowed, and the City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing
  Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to certify upon said registers that said
  demands are so approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority
  Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor/Successor
  Agency Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 301  AFFIRMATION OF CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT
  EXEMPTION (EA-CE-2020-036) RESCINDED; RESOLUTION NO. 20-71
  – RESCINDED. Staff report dated June 30, 2020, was presented recommending
  actions taken during the public hearing held on June 9, 2020, to consider the
  adoption of a resolution approving General Plan Amendment 2020-001 (GPA-
  2020-001) for an Environmental Justice Element to the General Plan be rescinded.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member
  Dotson that the City Council does hereby: 1) Rescind the affirmation of California
  Environmental Quality Act Exemption (EA-CE-2020-036); and 2) Rescind the
  adoption of Resolution No. 20-71. The motion was carried by the following roll
  call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Noes: None.

 301  AFFIRMATION OF CALIFORNIA ENVIROMENTAL QUALITY ACT
  EXEMPTION (EA-CE-2020-037) RESCINDED; RESOLUTION NO. 20-72
  RESCINDED. Staff report dated June 30, 2020, was presented recommending
  actions taken during the public hearing held on June 9, 2020, to consider the
  adoption of a resolution approving General Plan Amendment 2020-002 (GPA-
  2020-002) amending the Land Use Element of the Inglewood General Plan be
  rescinded.

  2
 June 30, 2020

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member
  Padilla that the City Council does hereby: 1) Rescind the affirmation of California
  Environmental Quality Act Exemption (EA-CE-2020-037; and 2) Rescind the
  adoption of Resolution No. 20-72. The motion was carried by the following roll
  call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Noes: None.

  183  RESOLUTION NO. 20-85 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE CITY’S
  MASTER FEE SCHEDULE. Staff report dated June 30, 2020, was presented
  recommending adoption of a resolution amending the City’s Master Fee Schedule
  to include permit parking fees for the Citywide Permit Parking District Program.

  It was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by Council Member
  Morales that Resolution No. 20-85 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE MASTER FEE
  SCHEDULE TO ADD PERMIT PARKING FEES FOR THE CITYWIDE
  PERMIT PARKING DISTRICT PROGRAM

  be adopted. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Noes: None.

  142  FISCAL YEAR 2018-2019 FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SINGLE
  AUDIT FOR CITY OF INGLEWOOD, AND THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  HOUSING AUTHORITY – RECEIVED AND FILED. Staff report dated June
  30, 2020, was presented presenting the Fiscal Year 2018-2019 Financial
  Statements and Single Audit for the City of Inglewood and the City of Inglewood
  Housing Authority.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member
  Franklin that the City Council does hereby: 1) Receive an oral presentation from
  the City’s audit firm, Lance, Soll & Lunghard, LLP, on the City’s Fiscal Year
  2018-2019 Basic Financial Statements and Single Audit Report on Federal
  Awards; and 2) Receive and file the City’s Basic Financial Statements and Single
  Audit Report on Federal Awards for Fiscal Year 2018-2019. The motion was
  carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Noes: None.

  It was moved by Housing Authority Member Morales, and seconded by Housing
  Authority Member Franklin that the Housing Authority does hereby receive and
  file the City of Inglewood Basic Financial Statements, which includes the
  Housing Authority financial accounts for Fiscal Year 2018-2019. The motion
  was carried by the following roll vote:
  Ayes: Housing Authority Member Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and
  Housing Authority Chairman Butts.
  Noes: None.

  301  PUBLIC HEARING CONTINUED – ESTABLISHING SHORT TERM
  RENTAL FEES. Mayor Butts ordered the public hearing continued to July 21,
  2020, at the hour of 2:00 p.m.

  3
 June 30, 2020

  301  PUBLIC HEARING HELD – CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION EA-CE-2020-
  036 AFFIRMED; RESOLUTION NO. 20-86 ADOPTED – GENERAL
  PLAN AMENDMENT 2020-001. The City Clerk announced that the next
  scheduled matter was a public hearing to consider the adoption of a resolution
  affirming Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2020-036 and approving General Plan
  Amendment 2020-001 (GPA 2020-001) to adopt an Environmental Justice

  and manner as required by law, that two correspondences dated June 30, 2020,

  Artie Field, City Manager, presented the staff report dated June 30, 2020.

  Fred Jackson, Senior Planner, gave an extended oral report.

  the City Council on this matter.

  Following discussion, it was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded
  by Council Member Franklin that the City Council does hereby: 1) Affirm
  California Environmental Quality Act Exemption (EA-CE-2020-036); and 2)
  Adopt Resolution No. 20-86 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA, TO ADOPT CATEGORICAL
  EXEMPTION EA-CA-2020-36 AND APPROVE GENERAL PLAN
  AMENDMENT  2020-001(GPA-2020-001) TO  ADOPT  AN
  ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE ELEMENT TO THE GENERAL PLAN

  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts;

  California Environmental Quality Act Exemption (EA-CE-2020-037); and 2)
  Adopt Resolution No. 20-87 entitled:
